findings.issue: Article extraction verifies only its first a[href], while allLinks marks every anchor under .gr-source-list as a source-article. An extra undeclared second anchor inside an existing source article passes the revised assertion.
findings.reproduction: Generated actual current selected-game sourceContent in Node VM, parsed its HTML and inserted one extra https://example.com/undeclared anchor inside the first existing article. Executed exact current sourceLinksProof against the parsed structure; it passed.
findings.impact: No mismatch in current app output, which emits exactly one anchor per source article. Complete provider metadata checks are valid; every-link exactness remains a qualified assertion-completeness limit.
findings.suggestion: Run owner may bind every source-article anchor to its declared article metadata and expected multiplicity; reviewer made no fixes.
